issues.description: OutputImageRawFrame uses raw bytes of PIL image without converting mode, will produce corrupted images
issues.detail: `image.tobytes()` returns raw pixel bytes in whatever mode PIL decoded (could be RGBA, P, L, etc.), but format is hardcoded to 'RGB'. If Gemini returns a PNG with alpha channel or palette mode, downstream consumers expecting RGB pixel data will render garbage or crash. Should call `image.convert('RGB')` first.

issues.description: Monkey-patching private genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time is fragile
issues.detail: Mutating a private module attribute (`genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE`) at import time will silently break if the upstream SDK renames or removes it, and affects all users of google-genai in the same process — not just this service. The comment acknowledges it's a hack; at minimum guard with hasattr and log a warning.

issues.description: Changing default model is a behavioral breaking change for existing users
issues.detail: Default model changed from `gemini-2.0-flash` to `gemini-2.5-flash`. Users relying on the default will silently get a different model with different latency, cost, and output characteristics. This is listed under 'Changed' in CHANGELOG but in semver terms warrants a more prominent migration note, especially since 2.5-flash has thinking enabled by default.

issues.description: Image detection via substring 'image' in model name is brittle
issues.detail: `if "image" in self._model_name` will match any future model with 'image' anywhere in its name, including possibly unrelated naming. A startswith check against known image-capable model prefixes, or an explicit capability flag, is safer and more discoverable.

issues.description: No error handling for PIL Image.open on potentially malformed inline_data
issues.detail: `Image.open(io.BytesIO(part.inline_data.data))` can raise `UnidentifiedImageError` or other exceptions if Gemini returns malformed bytes or an unexpected format. There's no try/except, so a single bad image response would crash the entire `_process_context` and break the pipeline.

issues.description: New example lacks resolution/format assumptions documentation and uses LLM as image source without sizing guarantees
issues.detail: The example sets `video_out_width=1024, video_out_height=1024` but nothing forces Gemini's returned image to match that size; the transport may scale/crop unexpectedly. Worth a comment noting the image will be resized to fit transport output dimensions, or asserting/resizing in the pipeline.

review.summary: The PR adds Gemini image generation support with a small, focused diff, but the image-handling code has correctness concerns. The biggest issue is that `image.tobytes()` is passed with a hardcoded `format='RGB'` without converting the PIL image mode, which will produce corrupted output for any non-RGB image (alpha, palette, grayscale). Secondary concerns include a fragile private-API monkey-patch on `genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE`, a brittle substring check for image models, missing error handling around PIL decoding, and an unannounced default model change. The new example is reasonable but doesn't document image-size assumptions.
